description: Register the Fullstack Development router instruction when a session starts or resumes.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' "If the Fullstack Development plugin is explicitly mentioned or invoked, first read $PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/using-fullstack-dev/SKILL.md."
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output \"If the Fullstack Development plugin is explicitly mentioned or invoked, first read $env:PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/using-fullstack-dev/SKILL.md.\""
